name: wal_skip_threshold
description: Minimum size (in kB) of a new file for which PostgreSQL skips WAL logging and instead uses direct fsync for persistence, applicable only when wal_level = 'minimal'.
symptoms: Excessive fsync overhead on small files
Data loss risk under crash when wal_level = minimal
Slower recovery due to inconsistent write methods
tuning_tips: Increase this value to reduce WAL volume for large bulk operations when wal_level = 'minimal'; decrease only if you observe excessive fsyncs on moderately sized files and can tolerate higher WAL overhead. Avoid changing unless using wal_level = 'minimal'.
